Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.
In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 5% of the target's current HP.
In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 5% of the target's lost HP.
This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.
You can use the human form to kite enemies, and the wolf form to fight.
